newsitem.title: USA: Pfizer says declares two-for-one stock split.
newsitem.headline: Pfizer says declares two-for-one stock split.

text.p: Pfizer Inc said Thursday it declared a two-for-one split of its common stock in the form of a 100-percent stock dividend to shareholders of record on June 2.

The company said the dividend is payable June 30 and also said it announced a $0.34 per share second-quarter cash dividend on a pre-split basis. The dividend is payable June 12 to shareholders of record May 9.
Pfizer said the cash dividend is its 234th consecutive quarterly dividend. The split followed a shareholders vote to increase the number of authorized common shares to three billion.
The company said this will be the eighth split of it's common stock since the company was publicly traded in 1942.
One share of that original offering will be equal to 1,296 shares after this latest split.
The company said the number of outstanding shares will double to about 1.26 billion as a result of the split.
